title: auditlog-agent won't upgrade: apt keeps resolving the old, buggy version as candidate
description_md:
`auditlog-agent` 1.0-1 has a known bug that floods disk with duplicate log lines. The fix (2.0-1) is already sitting in this host's internal package mirror, but no matter what you try, `apt-get install --only-upgrade auditlog-agent` (or a plain `apt-get upgrade`) refuses to move past 1.0-1 -- and `apt-cache policy` keeps agreeing that 1.0-1 is `Candidate`, as if 2.0-1 didn't exist. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`) and work out why apt won't consider the newer version, then get 2.0-1 actually installed.

You're done when `auditlog-agent` is both installed and the resolved candidate at version `2.0-1`.
